review.lacework.lacework.is.a.data-drive: Lacework is a data-driven cloud security platform that uses machine learning to automatically learn what's normal in your cloud environment and detect anomalies that could indicate threats, misconfigurations, or compliance violations.
The platform's Polygraph technology builds a behavioral baseline across your entire cloud infrastructure—including workloads, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud accounts—to identify suspicious activities without requiring custom rules or signatures.
